theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂ with
  | refl a => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | red_I a =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨a, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    | red_I => exact ⟨a, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par hc ha =>
      cases I_irreducible _ hc
      exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  | red_K a b =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨a, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
    | red_K => exact ⟨a, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨a', h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨a', h, .red_K _ _⟩
  | red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S _ _ _⟩
    | red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨a', b', ha, hb, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par ha hc) (.par hb hc), .red_S _ _ _⟩
  | @par a a' b b' ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | par ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := iha ha'
      obtain ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := ihb hb'
      exact ⟨_, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩
    | red_I =>
      cases I_irreducible _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    | red_K =>
      obtain ⟨a'', h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, h⟩
    | red_S =>
      obtain ⟨a'', c', ha', hc, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par ha' hb) (.par hc hb)⟩
